properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Core shipped asset: @noble/curves implements secp256k1 in src/secp256k1.ts with ECDSA (low-S normalized) and Schnorr/BIP340; default consumers are Bitcoin/Ethereum ecosystems. ECDLP on secp256k1 is broken by Shor.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Core shipped asset: src/ed25519.ts implements Ed25519/Ed25519ph/Ed25519ctx (EdDSA) plus ristretto255; the default EdDSA across the JS ecosystem. Shor-vulnerable signature scheme.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Core shipped asset: src/nist.ts implements P-256 (secp256r1) ECDSA and ECDH with RFC 9380 hash-to-curve. Shor-vulnerable NIST curve.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Core shipped asset: generic ECDSA engine in src/abstract/weierstrass.ts — deterministic nonces via HMAC (RFC6979), low-S option; instantiated for secp256k1, NIST P-256/384/521 and brainpool.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Core shipped asset: x25519 Montgomery-ladder Diffie-Hellman (getSharedSecret) in src/ed25519.ts — the classic harvest-now-decrypt-later target for captured key agreements.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Core shipped asset: ECDH key agreement across the library — Weierstrass getSharedSecret, x25519/x448 Montgomery DH, and WebCrypto DeriveBits wrappers in src/webcrypto.ts.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Core shipped asset: src/nist.ts implements P-384 (secp384r1) and P-521 (secp521r1) ECDSA/ECDH with hash-to-curve. Larger field sizes only delay the quantum break.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Core shipped asset: src/ed448.ts implements Ed448/Ed448ph (EdDSA over Curve448/Goldilocks, SHAKE prehash) and decaf448. Shor-vulnerable signature scheme.

properties.name: pqs:context
